title: Disposal of Land by Development Authorities Regulation Second Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Disposal of Land by Development Authorities Regulation Second Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

DISPOSAL OF LAND BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES
DISPOSAL OF LAND BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES
(REGULATION) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLVI OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation)
Act, 1998
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th August, 2002]
No. Legis.13‑30/94(Part‑I),
dated 26‑8‑2002.‑‑The following Ordinance
promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information:
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation) (Second Amendment)
Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment in section 4 of Act XII of 1998

DISPOSAL OF LAND BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES
DISPOSAL OF LAND BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES
(REGULATION) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLVI OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation)
Act, 1998
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th August, 2002]
No. Legis.13‑30/94(Part‑I),
dated 26‑8‑2002.‑‑The following Ordinance
promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information:
2. Amendment in section 4 of
Act XII of 1998.‑‑‑In the said Act, in section 4, after
clause (f) the following new clause (g) shall be added:‑‑
"(g) Notwithstanding
anything contained in this section Government may allow sale and disposal of
land in special circumstances at such rate and on such terms and conditions as
it may determine. "
